$comment: Bounded synthetic demonstration material. Nothing here derives from, describes, or stands in for any real institution, programme, policy, or disbursement.

evidence.$comment: The observation the runtime must open, verify and read a state from. Declaring it here does not satisfy anything: the policy source states the requirement, this file states the observation, and the runtime establishes satisfaction only by comparing the two.

declared_logical_times.$comment: The supersession record is admitted when v2 is enacted (2027-05-01) and becomes operative on v2's effective date (2027-06-01). The basis-completeness attestation is admitted after it, because the L0 resolver will not call an output CURRENT on an attestation older than a controlling record it would have had to cover. before_v2_effective therefore sits after the attestation and before v2 takes effect.

ztl.authority_note: Authority and delegation are institutional/OAM-plane facts. Encoding either as a ZTL proposition would let a logical result stand in for an institutional one; the formula therefore names neither.

frozen_demo_policy.on_authority_unresolved_note: A6 means competing operative authority bases with no frozen precedence. The decision records UNRESOLVED and escalates; it must never state that the proposition is false.
frozen_demo_policy.on_currentness_unknown_note: UNKNOWN fails closed operationally. It is not substantive falsity and never rewrites an epistemic result.
